title: Internal: Closing Business Checking Accounts
summary: This document defines pre-closure checks and tier-specific closure terms for business checking accounts: balances/fees conditions, OPEN status, no pending transactions, and closing linked OPEN business savings first. It specifies early closure fees and notice periods for ENTRY ($50/60 days, 7 days), MID ($100/90 days, 14 days), PREMIUM ($200/180 days, 21 days + supervisor review), and ELITE (>$100,000 credit lines: $400/270 days, 30 days + manager approval), then instructs using close_bank_account_7392 after verification.
faqs: What pre-closure requirements must be verified before closing a business checking account?
If the account closes early, what early closure fee and notice period apply for each tier (ENTRY, MID, PREMIUM, ELITE)?
For PREMIUM tier, do we need supervisor review before closing, and what’s the required notice period?
For ELITE tier accounts (credit lines over $100,000), do we need manager approval and what notice period/fee applies?
Does the early closure fee require an external payment method, or is it deducted from the account balance?
What are the step-by-step closure procedures, including which system function to use?
keywords: ENTRY TIER (Navy Blue) notice period 7 days
MID TIER (True Blue, Sky Blue) notice period 14 days
PREMIUM TIER (Cobalt Blue) supervisor review + 21-day notice
pre-closure requirement: account status must be OPEN
